name: Resend
summary: Resend is an email API for developers. The free plan covers 3,000 emails a month with a 100 a day cap. Pro starts at $20 a month for 50,000 emails, and Scale starts at $90 for 100,000. Dedicated IPs and single sign-on are paid add-ons on Scale only.

facts.text: Resend sends mail through a POST request to api.resend.com/emails, and the page we read does not mention SMTP.
Webhook event types include email.delivered, email.bounced, email.complained and email.suppressed.
Bounces are classed as permanent, transient or undetermined, and the dashboard shows the subtype with suggested next steps and lets you remove an address from the suppression list.
Resend says it is SOC 2 Type II compliant and GDPR compliant, holds no ISO 27001 certificate, is not HIPAA compliant and cannot sign a Business Associate Agreement.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 emails a day, 3 domains, 30 days of data

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: No daily limit, 10 domains, extra emails $0.90 per 1,000. A 100,000 email tier costs $35

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 1,000 domains. Tiers run to $1,150 for 2,500,000 emails, with extra emails from $0.90 down to $0.46 per 1,000

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom volume, flexible retention, single sign-on included

hiddenCosts: A dedicated IP costs $30 a month on Scale and is meant for senders above 3,000 emails a day.
Single sign-on costs $150 a month as a Scale add-on.
Each block of 100 extra domains costs $20 a month.
Plans are billed monthly with no annual discount.

security.ssoPlan: Scale add-on ($150 a month) or Enterprise

contract.cancellation: Renewal can be cancelled from the account page or through support. Resend may suspend or end accounts without prior notice.
